cards.subject: Aiden Perenolde
lines: Alterac's king took Horde gold in the Second War and let the orcs through his mountains, and held a prison camp full of Dalaran citizens besides.
The other kingdoms sacked his capital for it and Terenas deposed him. Most of the population simply left. All of this is the aftermath of one bribe.

cards.subject: Nothing is here
cards.tag: No town, no inn, no repair
lines: Every quest that sends you to Alterac is handed out down in Hillsbrad, at Tarren Mill or Southshore. You walk in and you walk out.
The friendliest thing in the whole zone is a goblin standing on a wall.
It is the emptiest zone in the game and it is that way on purpose.

cards.subject: Inside the dome
lines: The purple barrier is sealed. You cannot walk through it and there is no city under it.
Hunters with Eagle Eye and shamans with Far Sight could see over the wall, and warlocks could wedge an Eye of Kilrogg in between a ruin and the dome.
What is in there is bare ground.

cards.subject: Lordamere Internment Camp
cards.tag: On the hill above the crater
lines: One of the Second War camps where the defeated orcs were penned — women and infants included.
It is still garrisoned by Dalaran, and the live business there is Horde agents hunting four Forsaken deserters hiding inside.
Two prisons on one hillside: one for a people, one for a city.

cards.subject: The Syndicate
lines: They are Alterac's surviving aristocracy. Turned away everywhere after the betrayal, they began stealing to stay alive and never stopped.
They still intend to take the kingdom back: "We will do as we have always done: wait until a clear victor rises from the ashes and then strike."

cards.subject: Bro'kin
cards.tag: On the wall of the ruins
lines: A goblin selling alchemy supplies from the top of the northern wall of a dead human city held by ogres.
Neutral to everyone, no guards, no explanation.
There is a ramp up the inside of the keep wall. You either kill the ogres or sneak past them to shop.

cards.subject: Mug'thol
lines: Sylvanas's banshee possessed the ogre and sent him to fetch the crown out of Alterac.
He put it on instead, and it broke her hold on him.
He kept the crown, kept the ruins, and made himself a warlord in a human kingdom's throne room.

cards.subject: Growless Cave
cards.tag: Why the yeti have his things
lines: Helcular was a mage part-way through turning himself into a lich when a Southshore lynch mob found his cave and killed him.
The yeti took what was left, which is why the rod for the Tarren Mill chain drops off them.
People report killing them in the hundreds for it.

cards.subject: The Abominable Greench
lines: He lives in Growless Cave, added in patch 1.2.0, and he steals the Smokywood Pastures shipments and stuffs them in his lair.
For two weeks each Winter Veil the emptiest zone in the game gets the only crowd it ever sees.
All of it queued outside one cave.

cards.subject: Ravenholdt Manor
lines: The Assassin's League runs out of a house in the eastern mountains, reached by climbing a path off a plateau in Hillsbrad. Outsiders are told to leave.
You earn standing by taking emblems off Syndicate corpses.
Their view of the Syndicate: hacks — disorganized, unskilled, and lazy.

cards.subject: Dandred's Fold
lines: A small farm, and the last prince of Alterac is hiding in it — Aliden Perenolde, the traitor king's son, with his mistress and an orc warlock for a bodyguard.
The heir to a kingdom, in a borrowed barn.
Taretha Foxton's necklace is in there too.

cards.subject: The battleground's door is not here
lines: Both entrances are down in Hillsbrad Foothills — north of Southshore, northeast of Tarren Mill.
The zone the battleground is named after does not contain the way in.

cards.subject: What happens to this place
lines: In 4.0.3a nearly every quest here is deleted and Alterac stops being a zone at all — it gets absorbed into Hillsbrad.
The prince is removed and his farm left empty. The internment camp is demolished and a farm built over it.
Of Crushridge Hold: "this area no longer serves any in-game purpose."
